title.zh-TW: 圖片載入從模糊變清楚

summary.zh-TW: 圖片還在載入時先顯示很模糊的預覽，載入完成後由模糊漸漸變清楚。每張圖載入時間不同，所以會一張一張清楚起來；圖片框大小固定，版面不會跳。
summary.en: While images load, a very blurred preview shows; once loaded, each sharpens into focus. Load times differ, so they clear one by one, and the fixed frames keep the layout still.

text.zh-TW: 預覽圖先模糊，載入完成後補間到 0。真實做法是先放一張很小的低解析度圖，img 的 load 事件觸發時再換成清楚的。
text.en: The preview starts blurred and tweens to 0 on load. In practice you show a tiny low-res image first and swap on the img load event.

text.zh-TW: 模糊會讓邊緣變淡、露出底色，稍微放大可以把淡掉的邊緣藏到框外面，清楚時再縮回原尺寸。
text.en: Blur fades the edges and reveals the background; scaling up slightly hides those edges outside the frame until it sharpens.

text.zh-TW: 圖片框先決定比例，載入前後大小都一樣，下面的內容不會因為圖片載入而被推動。
text.en: The frame’s ratio is fixed up front, so its size never changes and content below isn’t pushed when images load.

text.zh-TW: 示範用：每張圖片的「載入時間」寫在 HTML 上，所以會一張一張變清楚。真實情況直接聽 load 事件。
text.en: For the demo each image’s “load time” lives in the HTML, so they clear one at a time. In production, listen for the load event.
